verdict.rationale: Epic's physics docs describe Chaos Physics as a built-in simulation system that includes Rigid Body Dynamics. The same page links dedicated first-party pages for Collision and for Traces with Raycasts, so all three story elements are covered out of the box. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence on collision and raycast behavior (only linked page titles are shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration that physics works out of the box.

support.subject: As a game developer, built-in physics — rigid bodies, collisions, raycasts — works out of the box

citations.quote: Chaos Physics is a light-weight physics simulation solution available in Unreal Engine, built from the ground up to meet the needs of next-generation games.
Collision — All about collision, collision responses, and collision presets in Unreal Engine
Traces with Raycasts — The landing page for Physics Traces.
